message.content:
**Northbank Community Garden**

**North gate closed: Saturday 18 April, 9 am to 2 pm**

A water pipe near the north gate is leaking, and it will be repaired on Saturday. The gate will stay shut from 9 am until 2 pm while the work is done. Please keep clear of the repair area and don't try to get past any barriers.

During those hours, use the east entrance. You can still reach the beds and paths from that side.

**Seed swap moved to Sunday**

The seed swap will now take place on Sunday at 11 am instead of Saturday. Bring the seeds you've saved, labelled if possible, and take home what you plan to grow. The time is the only change. Everything else about the swap stays the same.

**Volunteers**

If you're volunteering, bring your own gloves. Tools are supplied, so there's no need to carry spades or forks from home. Mina, one of our residents, is coordinating volunteers. Talk to her if you'd like to help or if your plans change after you've signed up.

The north gate will reopen at 2 pm once the repair is finished.
